adjudication.rationale:
Yes. In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration loops through `records.each do |h|` and runs:

```rb
execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, category_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)"
```

`h` is interpolated directly into a SQL string inside single quotes without any escaping/quoting helper. If `h` contains a single quote (or other SQL-significant characters), the generated SQL becomes invalid and can break the migration mid-run; it also creates a SQL injection risk from the `site_settings` value. Using `connection.quote(h)` or parameterized/bound execution would avoid this.
